title: Beyond Optimizely: Malicious Scripts Traced Across Four Web Services
description: Malicious JavaScript was injected into customer projects via a vulnerability in Optimizely's Experimentation signup workflow, affecting 188 snippets across 178 organizations including major enterprises. The attack involved four web services: Optimizely, Kissmetrics, StorifyMe, and minute-ly. The malicious code replaced cryptocurrency addresses, monitored payment card details, and established a mobile delivery path linked to known threat groups Coruna and DarkSword. Later-stage iOS modules targeted keychain databases and private keys, although successful exploitation of these modules is unconfirmed. Optimizely has patched the vulnerability and removed injected code, but some access paths remain under investigation. The attack infrastructure used specific routing channels and collection domains. No confirmed exploits in the wild have been reported.
